evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: four canopy nodes (amber, ochre, graphite, rust) with amber dot-lines converging into a central web; by shot-08s the graphite node's hyphae curl dark and the rust node dims, but reversal direction is not legible in still frames.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: glowing sphere nodes, blurred shade bands, branching hyphae and a gradient ground; by shot-20s an eight-node radial mirror with two crossing shade bands. One simulation layer, low dot count, no visible Gray-Scott pattern, about 29% of budget used.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream and rust palette with shaded sphere nodes and soft halos is coherent, but the shade blobs show pixelated edges and the hyphae are jagged dotted lines; by shot-20s vertical banding stripes run through the background gradient.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: fungal sink-and-shade concept on a cream ground with amber and rust hyphae is absent from the anchors (weave, Chladni, birds, dish); by shot-20s the radial mirror of eight nodes with crossing shade bands reads as its own image.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: off-centre composition with the nodes low and a small caption bottom-left; shot-08s frame is half empty on the right; shot-20s resolves to a symmetric X layout that differs clearly from the 2s start.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so there is no head-to-head comparison.

critique.change: Make the reversal legible: at the 6.5 s cut, draw bright moving heads with short trails on the dimmed node's hyphae so the flip toward the shaded node is visible in shot-08s, not only implied by dim colour.
Raise the dot density to the brief's counts and draw the Gray-Scott spot pattern on the central web so shot-20s reads as a dense living network instead of sparse lines.

Render the shade bands with a soft full-resolution falloff instead of blocky blur, dither the background gradient to remove the vertical banding seen at shot-20s, and centre the shot-08s frame on the nodes.
